messages:
sam: paging — receiving multiple customer reports where LLM responses contain tokens from a different model variant after a region fallback. Appears related to smart-routing fallback + KV cache prefixing. paging @oncall :pagerduty:

incbot: INCIDENT CREATED • INC-1862345678 • severity: sev2 • routed to #incidents • pager duty notified :rotating_light:

sam: timeline: started ~1862345600; symptoms: short-lived spikes of wrong-variant completions (model A outputs observed when request routed to model B variant). Affected region: us-east -> fallback to eu-west.

maria: seeing logs that look suspicious — KV prefix used for cached past-key-values is missing region tag for some requests. digging.

lee: important: last infra change to routing policy yesterday added a compatibility fallback that allows variant-compatible caches to be reused. suspect policy is too permissive and cache key scheme doesn't include region.

maria: pulling a few example request ids: req-6b7c, req-6d8f, req-6f12. Running query on kv-store: 

maria: ```
# list keys matching model variants
redis-cli --scan --pattern "kv:cache:modelA:*" | head
# example returned duplicates across regions
kv:cache:modelA:prefix:global:sha1... -> node eu-west-1
kv:cache:modelA:prefix::sha1... -> node us-east-1
```

maria: see the empty region token in the second key — that’s the root cause for cross-region reuse.

tasha: oncall taking — I'm joining. quick mitigation idea: rotate routing policy to disable variant-compatible cache reuse, and purge ambiguous keys that lack region. Can we do a targeted purge?

lee: agree. mitigation plan (fast): 1) disable compatibility fallback in smart-routing (feature-flag) 2) run targeted purge for keys missing region component 3) monitor error/latency/response-variant metrics 4) re-enable after verification.

maria: preparing purge script now. Will only delete keys matching pattern with empty/malformed region field.

maria: ```bash
# dry-run
redis-cli --scan --pattern "kv:cache:model*:*" | awk -F":" '$4=="" {print $0}' | tee /tmp/purge_candidates
# actual purge (careful):
cat /tmp/purge_candidates | xargs -L1 redis-cli del
```

sam: +1 to dry-run first and post counts. we should also throttle deletes to avoid load spikes on redis cluster.

infra-bot: deployment rollback suggested: routing-policy v3.2.1 -> v3.1.9 available. rollback requires 5m maintenance window.

tasha: rollback is risky for other customers; I'd prefer feature-flag disable first. if feature-flag doesn't stop issue, escalate to rollback.

zahra: support note: I've flagged top 3 paying customers who reported issues (acme-inc, dataflowio, searchly). Messaging prepared: "We're aware of an issue impacting model variant consistency — mitigation in progress. No customer data exposed; output quality may be degraded. We'll follow up." Want to wait for confirmation before sending.

lee: running correlation query to count affected requests per minute: currently ~120rpm showing wrong-variant responses across ~8% of fallbacks in last 30m.

maria: dry-run purge found 2,342 candidate keys across two shards. proceeding with throttled delete (rate 200 keys/min). starting now.

maria: DELETE STEP LOG: deleted 400 keys (shard-a), deleted 380 keys (shard-b), 200 keys paused due to spike; continuing.

sam: monitoring application layer — we should see variant mismatch rate drop within 2x token windows (KV effect).

lee: adding a short patch to prefix generation to include region tag for future keys. will push to canary after purge. patch: make cache key = model:variant:region:prefix-hash.

maria: purge complete. removed 2,342 ambiguous keys. no redis errors observed, cluster CPU within normal.

tasha: feature-flag toggled: compatibility_fallback=false for smart-routing in prod. watching metrics.

lee: canary patch deployed to 10% routing nodes to include region in keys. logging enabled to verify new keys have region in position 3.

sam: observed wrong-variant rate dropped from 8% -> 0.4% over 15m. good sign.

zahra: sending customer update now to the three impacted customers with the note + ETA for follow-up.

zahra: "Update: We've applied mitigations to routing and cache keys; you may see improved consistency. We're doing a post-incident analysis and will share findings within 48 hours. If you still observe issues, please reply with example request ids."

infra-bot: monitoring alert: latency bump + provisioning alert on eu-west-1 during purge window but back to normal.

maria: follow-up: root cause appears to be a regression introduced in routing-policy rollout v3.2.1 — compatibility_fallback logic allowed keys to be written without populating region when a specific codepath falls back before region tagging. Need postmortem and revert of that codepath.

lee: action items (in ticket ops#1862345678): 1) roll a targeted fix to routing-policy to ensure region never empty in keygen 2) add unit + integration test for prefix composition 3) add metric for "ambiguous-kv-keys" 4) schedule postmortem and customer RCA.

tasha: handing off to lee for the remainder of the incident; I'll remain on-call for the next 30m for any regressions.

lee: taking over. timeline + notes will be added to the incident doc. assigning postmortem owner: lee.

sam: final severity downgrade to sev3 at 1862346900; monitoring for any recurrence.

zahra: customers notified. support queue flagged number 42 for follow-ups.

lee: small additional note: add routing-policy pre-deploy check to validate that fallback path includes region tag in simulated fallbacks. prevents similar silent regressions.

sam: thanks everyone. postmortem draft due in 72h. big thumbs for quick coordinated mitigation :thumbsup:

incbot: INCIDENT RESOLVED • INC-1862345678 • resolution: compatibility_fallback disabled + purge + key-fix deployed to canary • severity: downgraded -> monitoring :white_check_mark:
